description: Create a release gate for a pack of tests: it passes a deploy when the share of the pack's tests that pass reaches required_pass_percentage. Make the pack first with create_gate_pack when none fits. CI calls the gate with a deploy token, made in the app (Release gates, CI integration); `qualiloop gate ci-snippet <gate>` prints the script.

active.description: False makes it off: CI calls are refused.
active.title: Active

ci_timeout_minutes.description: How long CI waits for a run before it fails.
ci_timeout_minutes.title: Ci Timeout Minutes

pack.description: The pack of tests it runs: its id or name, as list_gate_packs shows it.
pack.title: Pack

required_pass_percentage.description: The share of tests that must pass, in percent.
required_pass_percentage.title: Required Pass Percentage

name: create_release_gate
